data.define: A casual word for good, or for agreeing.

misuse.text: Don't say 'cool' when someone shares sad news.
misuse.why: It sounds like you don't care.

data.l1_hook: आज रात छह बजे फिल्म, ठीक है? 'cool'।

native.tip: “cool” = बढ़िया; ठीक है; बहुत अच्छा. उदाहरण: “Cool, see you at six!”
native.caption:

उदाहरण: “Cool, see you at six!” ('cool', छह बजे मिलते हैं!)
